name: Angel
summary: Something larger than you, looking on or lending a hand.

name: Banner
summary: A message carried high for everyone to see.

name: Bird
summary: A small, free voice, often easy to miss.

name: Blindfold
summary: Not seeing, by choice or not: what you can’t or won’t look at yet.

name: Boat
summary: Crossing over: carrying something from one shore to the next.

name: Bridge
summary: A way across, back or forward.

name: Bull
summary: Steady, stubborn strength, rooted in the earth.

name: Bundle
summary: What you carry with you, and how much of it you need.

name: Chains and bonds
summary: What holds you, and how tightly it really does.

name: Child
summary: Openness, play, and something new beginning.

name: Cloud
summary: Weather passing over: worry, mystery, or a change coming.

name: Crayfish
summary: Something rising from the deep, half-formed, not yet sure it wants the light.

name: Cross
summary: Where two directions meet: heaven and earth, spirit and matter.

name: Crown
summary: Authority, and the weight that comes with it.

name: Cup
summary: Feelings, and what you hold, offer, or receive.

name: Dance
summary: Moving with life instead of against it.

name: Dew
summary: Quiet nourishment that falls whether or not you notice it.

name: Dog
summary: Instinct and loyalty: the tame, companion part of you.

name: Fish
summary: Ideas and feelings rising from deep water.

name: Flowers
summary: Roses, lilies and garlands: tenderness, growth, a heart left open.

name: The four creatures
summary: Angel, eagle, lion and bull in the corners: every part of life, watching over.

name: Garden
summary: Something tended over time until it gives back.

name: Globe
summary: The whole world held in one hand: reach, and responsibility.

name: Hand from a cloud
summary: A gift offered from beyond what you can see. Every Ace has one.

name: Harvest
summary: What has grown, ripened, and is ready to be gathered.

name: Heart
summary: Feeling at its most direct, where hurt and love both land.

name: Heights and edges
summary: Cliffs, peaks and high ground: a wider view, and the step that comes next.

name: Horse
summary: Movement and drive: how fast, and who is steering.

name: House
summary: Home, family, and what you’ve built to shelter in.

name: Infinity
summary: The sideways eight: energy that keeps renewing itself.

name: Keys
summary: Access: what is open to you, and who decides.

name: Lantern
summary: A small light, enough for the next step.

name: Lightning
summary: A sudden flash that changes everything it touches.

name: Lion
summary: Raw strength and passion, wild or gently held.

name: Moon
summary: Reflected light: dreams, intuition, and what is only half seen.

name: Path
summary: The way forward, even when you can't see where it ends.

name: Pentacle
summary: The body, money and daily life: things you can hold.

name: Pillars
summary: A threshold between two opposites, like light and dark.

name: Pomegranates
summary: Many seeds in one fruit: hidden richness, waiting.

name: Rainbow
summary: A promise after the storm.

name: Ram
summary: Drive and will, head first.

name: Scales
summary: Weighing things fairly: give and take, cause and effect.

name: Sceptre
summary: The power to direct, and how it's used.

name: Scroll
summary: Knowledge, partly shown and partly kept back.

name: Serpent
summary: Change and renewal, or temptation, depending on where it coils.

name: Snow
summary: A cold, hard season, and the hope that it passes.

name: Sphinx
summary: A riddle to answer, and balance held still.

name: Star
summary: Hope, and guidance from far away.

name: Sun
summary: Clarity, warmth, and things out in the open.

name: Sword
summary: Thought and words: they can cut through, or cut.

name: Table
summary: What you have laid out in front of you to work with.

name: Throne
summary: A seat of steady power: where you rule from.

name: Tomb
summary: A resting place: deep rest, or something laid down for good.

name: Torch
summary: A fierce light that can guide or burn.

name: Tower
summary: Something built: shelter, a boundary, or a gate.

name: Tree
summary: Roots and growth over time.

name: Trumpet
summary: A call you can’t ignore.

name: Veil
summary: What is just out of view, for now.

name: Wands and staffs
summary: Energy, will, and something to lean on.

name: Water
summary: Feelings and the unconscious: still, pouring, or deep.

name: Wheel
summary: Cycles: what turns, and what comes round again.

name: Window
summary: Warmth and help, seen from outside.

name: Wolf
summary: The wild instinct that won't be tamed.

name: Wreath
summary: Recognition, and the circle of a victory.
